an mbarrier completes the numbered phase; the line rises to the warps whose wait it ends
On a wait, B2: the warp waits for phase 2 of mbarrier B. On a TMA load, →B: it reports its bytes to B.
CTA (0, 0, 0). Simulated time from warplens's approximate model, not a measurement. B200: illustrative parameters, 8 of 13 assumed and none fitted to hardware.
